description: AGSC-08-06's DCO-Plus trailer grammar, case for case as prov-0004, which it supersedes, with a fictitious contributor (`Ada Example <ada@example.org>`, operator `human:ada`) and a neutral producer (`example-model/1.0`) in every sample line. Every case is read straight off the ABNF of that rule. (1) A bare signoff conforms: `signoff = "Signed-off-by:" SP name SP "<" email ">" SP "(" agreement ")"`, with `agreement = "CA-v1"`; `name` admits internal spaces and the email boundary is the LAST `SP "<"` on the line. (2) `trailer-block = signoff *( LF assisted )` admits zero or more Assisted-by lines, whose `actor` is exactly the `human:<id>` form AGSC-02-07 requires of prov.operator. (3) A missing `(CA-v1)` is malformed. (4) `name` MUST NOT end with SP. (5) An actor that is not `human:<id>` is malformed. (6) An `idchar` outside `lcalpha / DIGIT / "." / "_" / "-"` — an upper-case letter — is malformed. Every malformed case is AGSC-E504.

trailers.block:
Signed-off-by: Ada Example <ada@example.org> (CA-v1)
Assisted-by: example-model/1.0 (operator: human:ada)
trailers.name: signoff-and-assisted

trailers.block:
Signed-off-by: Ada Example <ada@example.org> (CA-v1)
Assisted-by: example-model/1.0 (operator: agent:example)
trailers.name: actor-not-human

trailers.block:
Signed-off-by: Ada Example <ada@example.org> (CA-v1)
Assisted-by: example-model/1.0 (operator: human:Ada)
trailers.name: actor-uppercase

note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6 as the successor of prov-0004; the sample lines changed, the expected results are prov-0004's, derived by hand from the ABNF
